Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic въспалѣниѥ (vŭspalěnije, “combustion, inflammation”). By surface analysis, воспали́ть (vospalítʹ) + -е́ние (-énije). The modern meaning is probably a semantic loan from French inflammation.
